name: Video Downloader
description: Download videos and audio from YouTube and other sites (MP4, WebM, HLS, DASH). Recovers from HTTP 403 with player-signed URLs.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' blob: https://unpkg.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; child-src 'self';
